reply_body:
Hello Jari,

Thanks for getting in touch. I want to clarify our policy on cosmetic damage, since I think there's a misunderstanding. Cosmetic damage that doesn't affect how the equipment operates isn't fully waived - our policy is to charge 50% of the standard repair-cost schedule line for that type of damage, rather than the full amount. It isn't only chargeable if the machine stops working.

Because the charge was assessed and communicated to you against that repair-cost schedule, it's final - we're not able to remove or renegotiate it after the event, and that applies across the board, including for long-standing customers, so it isn't a reflection of how we view the account.

If you'd like, send over the invoice and I'll double-check the charge was calculated correctly against the schedule.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for flagging this. I want to correct a misunderstanding - our policy isn't that late returns are free for the first three days every time. What we offer is one grace day free of the late fee per rolling 12-month period, and only when we're notified before the agreed return date that the return will be late.

If you let us know before the agreed end date that you're running over, and haven't already used your grace day in the past 12 months, that day is waived. Outside of that, the late return fee applies for each day past the agreed end date.

Could you confirm whether you notified us in advance of the return date this time? If so, I'll check whether the grace day should have applied and correct the invoice if needed. If not, the charge stands as billed.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service
